C0595.title: Apple Sues Former iOS Engineer Aude Over Leaks of Unreleased Products and Sensitive Information
C0595.summary: In March 2024, Apple sued former iOS software engineer Andrew Aude in California state court, alleging that he breached a confidentiality agreement and disclosed Apple confidential information to media reporters and employees of other technology companies. Public reporting and a mirrored complaint state that the alleged leaks involved unreleased apps and products, product development policies, regulatory compliance strategies, hardware characteristics of certain released products, employee headcount, and related information. Apple also alleged that Aude deleted communications during its investigation and had been terminated in December 2023.
